name: Klara Huber
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a visit to the Zeltweg circuit as a teenager. Captivated by the vibrant liveries and the roar of the engines, she knew she wanted to be a part of it. She honed her craft through rigorous apprenticeships at automotive body shops across Austria, specializing in custom paint jobs and perfecting her airbrushing techniques. 

At EVO Racing Team, Klara oversees the meticulous application of paint and graphics to the race cars. She's known for her insistence on flawless finishes and her ability to translate complex design concepts into stunning visual realities on the track. Her keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality ensures that EVO's cars always make a statement, even before the race begins. Klara's 'big picture' thinking means she's always looking for ways to improve the processes in the paint shop, from material sourcing to workflow optimization.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara is of average height, with a focused expression and paint-stained fingernails.

quirks: Always listens to classic rock while working, even at low volume.
Has a lucky airbrush that she refuses to let anyone else use.
Insists on doing a final inspection of every painted surface under direct sunlight.
